From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Coupa invite — referrer stripped by corporate FW (debug logs attached)

Monica / Priyom — forwarding Elena's report. Quick notes from Onboard SRE (copied below):

- Root cause: the redirect chain from coupa -> our invite acceptor strips/normalizes Referrer and drops query params when the client sends a restrictive Referrer-Policy or the firewall mangles the header. Coupa validates token+referrer and rejects if mismatch.
- Short-term fix: create a 'direct accept' URL that embeds a one-time token in the path (no redirect) and returns HTML with the acceptance form. This bypasses cross-site referer checks.
- Workaround we can offer now: resend invite with a small attachment that contains the accept token and instructions (users paste token into a short form). Ugly but fast.

I attached debug-headers.log from the Thorpe repro. Action items:
- Monica: please confirm with Engineering whether we can emit a direct-accept route under coupa-accept.redwood-inference.com and a TTL of 1 hour.
- Priyom: please draft customer-facing text (2 options: short token-paste flow and DocuSign fallback) so we can send to Thorpe while engineering moves.

Onboard SRE note (excerpt):
"We see the token present in the initial redirect but missing on subsequent request. Suggest issuing a path-based token and bypassing external redirect flow; low-risk and short-lived."

Thanks — Ben
